intro.body: Fill crates to ten, count on, and spot shapes. Then finish on paper.
intro.audioText: Hold the bigger number. Count on for each extra coin. Ten fills a crate.

technique.title: Fill a ten-frame
technique.body: A ten-frame is two rows of five. Drop coins into the cells. Ten fills the crate. Empty cells are what is left to ten.
technique.audioText: A ten-frame is two rows of five. Drop coins into the cells. Ten fills the crate.

paper.prompt: Draw a ten-frame. Fill 8. How many empty?

technique.title: Count on
technique.body: Hold the bigger number in your head. Count on one for each extra coin.
technique.audioText: Hold the bigger number in your head. Count on for each extra coin.

technique.title: Before, after, bigger
technique.body: After a number is one more. Before is one less. Bigger means farther along the count.
technique.audioText: After a number is one more. Before is one less.

paper.prompt: Write the number before 8 and the number after 8.

technique.title: Name the outline
technique.body: A circle is round. A square has four equal sides. A triangle has three sides.
technique.audioText: A circle is round. A square has four equal sides. A triangle has three sides.

paper.prompt: Draw a circle, a square, and a triangle. Label each.

technique.title: Count by twos
technique.audioText: Pair the coins. Count by twos: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10.
